title: Core proper inverse-system construction
statement: theorem exists_proper_limit_noetherian_core {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] : ∃ (Λ : Type u) (_ : Preorder Λ) (_ : Nonempty Λ) (_ : IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)) (Xs Ss : Λᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (fs : Xs ⟶ Ss) (πX : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj X ⟶ Xs) (πS : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj S ⟶ Ss), Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk X πX)) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk S πS)) ∧ (∀ (i j : Λᵒᵖ) (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (Xs.map a) ∧ IsAffineHom (Ss.map a)) ∧ (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, IsProper (fs.app i)) ∧ (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, LocallyOfFiniteType (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Ss.obj i)) ∧ QuasiCompact (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Ss.obj i))) ∧ (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, πX.app i ≫ fs.app i = f ≫ πS.app i)
